name: Norviq
summary: Norviq (norviq.dev, github.com/norviq-dev/norviq) is an Apache-2.0 open-source policy enforcement point (PEP) for LLM agent tool calls on Kubernetes. Before a tool runs, an SDK or injected sidecar sends the call to POST /api/v1/evaluate, which evaluates OPA/Rego policy scoped to the workload's Kubernetes/SPIFFE identity and answers allow / block / escalate / audit. From v0.2.6 a shipped baseline enforces; evaluation is fail-closed within an enforcing namespace but fail-open by default, and the gate is cooperative: code that calls a tool without asking reaches it unjudged. Self-hosted; v0.2.8.

payments.notes: Apache-2.0 open source, self-hosted; the README states no usage limits and there is no billing. It installs from a cosign-signed OCI Helm chart with digest-pinned images. No hosted or paid edition is published (the site footer reads only '(c) 2026 Norviq, Apache 2.0'). No machine-payable surface.

agentAccess.notes: Self-hosted on Kubernetes (1.30+) via Helm; no vendor account or hosted key, so noAccountNeeded is true. The agent-facing decision call is POST /api/v1/evaluate, carrying an operator-minted per-workload token (a webhook-minted HS256 token by default, or a SPIFFE SVID). v0.2.8.

jobs.summary: POST /api/v1/evaluate returns allow / block / escalate / audit before a call runs, from OPA/Rego policy scoped to the workload's K8s/SPIFFE identity. From 0.2.6 a shipped baseline enforces; fail-closed in an enforcing namespace, fail-open by default, cooperative. README/security model; not measured.
